shared_elements: standing male figure in profile, facing right/left, filling the panel
bearded figure with elaborately curled/patterned beard
long fringed robe with incised drapery lines
figure holding an object in a raised fist
low-relief carving with fine incised linear detail (hair, beard, garment fringe)
arm bent at elbow across the body
justification: Both show a single large bearded male figure in strict profile occupying the whole panel, with a headdress, a long fringed robe rendered in fine parallel incised lines, and a hand closed around a held object at chest height — a very specific shared scheme of low-relief courtly/divine figure rendering. The chief differences are that A's figure is winged and surrounded by stylised plant/palmette motifs while B's figure is wingless, holds a long vertical spear and carries a bow, and stands in an otherwise empty field.
